segments.normalizedSource: ```swift let url = URL(string: "https://example.com")! @State private var message = "Loading..." var body: some View { Text(message) .task { do { var receivedLines = [String]() for try await line in url.lines { receivedLines.append(line) message = "Received \(receivedLines.count) lines" } } catch { message = "Failed to load" } } } ```
